metadata.source_excerpt: Hi all! After multiple rejections I finally got an interview for a PhD applied science intern role at Amazon in the EU (Germany or Ams). I have two interviews scheduled after each other next week and need help preparing for those. The thing is, I have never given a technical interview ever, I am confident regarding the machine learning breath one but not the DSA/coding one. I have never studied this (or leetcoded) and also did not code much recently (AI does a better job than me in coding). Should I just cancel the interview as I know I am going to mess this up or try my best and prepare? How was your experience?    submitted by    /u/ade17_in   [link] [comments]
